state:
**Goal `deprecated-and-todo`. Stages 2 to 6 are on disk; only Stage 7, the proofs, is left.** A `W1003` names its filled template and carries it as a safe fix (`nvs-types`), the editor shows it, `nvs check` lists todos, denies and fixes, and `[errors] deprecated` now acts while a program runs.

The runtime check: the checker records each use's message in `ExprTypeTable::deprecation_checks` and each deprecated method's in `deprecated_entry` (`crates/nvs-types/src/expr_table.rs`, filled by `crates/nvs-types/src/deprecated.rs` `report` and `record_entry`). `nvs-ir` lowers them to `InstKind::DeprecationCheck`, at a use in `lower_expr` and at a method's entry in `lower_method`. `nvs-codegen`'s `emit_deprecation_check` loads `DEPRECATED_OFFSET` (offset 48, in the hot line) and branches to `nvs_deprecated_use` (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/deprecated.rs`). `Ctx::refresh_limits` writes the word from the config, so `Core\Config::set` and `restore` reach it. `Core\DeprecatedError` is a `LogicError` in `nvs_hir::errors::TREE` and `ThrownClass::Deprecated`. `"log"` writes one `Warn` record per site per request, keyed by the site's message address. Tests: `crates/nvs-codegen/tests/deprecations.rs` and the conformance case `tests/conformance/lang/a-deprecated-use-throws-only-when-the-setting-says-so.nvst`. The rule `errors/a-use-of-deprecated-code-may-log-or-throw` is `shipped`.

**Known gaps, not yet owned by a test:** a use inside a property initializer, a constant's value or a parameter default does not warn, so it gets no runtime check either; a write to a deprecated property checks only where the target goes through `lower_expr`; a method's entry check has no use site, so its log record names no file and line; a static call reached through a subclass names the declaring class; a passed deprecated parameter gets no fix (help only); completion tags a deprecated member but not a deprecated class name.

**One deviation for the user to confirm:** ADR 0275 § Diagnostics adds no code except the template refusals. The goal also asks that an attach site the attribute does not take be refused, and no existing code says that. `E0844` is that code. If it should go, `E0454` could carry the hook case instead, with a worse message.

items.text: **Put the attribute, the todo comment, the setting and `Core\DeprecatedError` on the roster and give each its proofs** — `rule:testing/feature-proofs`: the roster is built by `tools/nv/proofs/roster.ts:183` from `#` headings in `docs/reference/lang/*.md` and from `nvs meta --json`. `#[Core\Deprecated]` needs a heading near `docs/reference/lang/90-attributes.md:143`, the todo comment one beside `docs/reference/lang/10-programs.md:118`; `directive:errors.deprecated` is `crates/nvs-config/src/directive.rs:168`, and the exception is `crates/nvs-hir/src/errors.rs:116`. Then `bun nv proofs --id '<feature>'` for each says what it owes. Test: the stage-7 `bun nv proofs --gate` check.
**Close the goal** — `bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes deprecated-and-todo`, move the standing decisions in `docs/agent/goals/deprecated-and-todo.md:1` to their rules, and write `DONE`.
